title: HOLE UP GAMERS
synopsis: In the near future, the full-dive VR game "Visions" is popular in Japan. However, the game has a flaw, and players who exploit it by staying logged in for extended periods are dying. An attempt is made to log all players out to stop the game, but some players rebel. In order to bring the players who have barricaded themselves in the game back to reality, the protagonist, Kokoro Hato, who works in the community welfare department's hikikomori (social withdrawal) countermeasures office, travels to the world of "Visions" and makes contact with the players...? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Youki died in a traffic accident and was reborn in a fantasy world! However, instead of being the hero of legends, he ended up reincarnating into an overpowered demon. Having no desire to become the Demon Lord, he sits around in the Demon Lord's castle as a random low rank guardian. One day, the Hero's party comes to attack and on a whim he knocks out the entire hero party. Healing up the Hero party and then preparing to send them back to town, he notices the female priest and falls in love at first sight! (Source: Manga Mirai)

synopsis: When a high school teacher was hospitalized due to bullying by students, a new teacher is assigned to replace him. The substitute teacher Ms. Kasai is a beautiful woman, with a stunning figure. On top of that, she doesn't get bothered by risqué remarks, always responding with a smile. Even as she laughs and says, “I became a teacher to make my students happy,” her students are already making evil plans. But what the bullies don’t know — is that Ms. Kasai is a psychopath.
